_comment: Copy this file to providers.json (gitignored) and fill in api_key values. Each top-level key is a provider NAME you select at runtime with --provider <name> --model <id>. 'protocol' is the default wire format (openai|anthropic); 'models' optionally overrides the protocol per model id (needed for OpenCode Go, which serves some models as openai and others as anthropic). --opencode-go <id> is sugar for --provider opencode-go --model <id>.
